calls.text: {"meetingId": "409", "tickets": [{"title": "Obtain Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary", "text": "Obtain the Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary from Beren Nettlewhisk of Paper Otter Tax Services by April 18, 2024.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-18", "assigneeId": "405a0bba-bb14-5076-904a-cb26172e4fcb", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by April 18, 2024.", "templateId": null}, {"title": "Resolve Velvet Acorn taxable account dividend variance", "text": "Resolve the Velvet Acorn taxable account dividend variance of $7,440 ordinary dividends versus $14,860 listed in the IRS correspondence by April 24, 2024.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-24", "assigneeId": "9268210f-ef66-5a4b-88ad-788a4cfe5d2d", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "the IRS correspondence lists $14,860 of ordinary dividends from the Velvet Acorn taxable account, while the return worksheet reviewed during the call shows $7,440 for the same income category; resolution of the custodian income variance is needed by April 24, 2024.", "templateId": null}, {"title": "Send notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements via secure delivery", "text": "Send the notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements to Anika Pebblefizz through secure delivery by April 16, 2024.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-04-16", "assigneeId": "405a0bba-bb14-5076-904a-cb26172e4fcb", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Anika authorized coordination with Beren and requested that only the notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements be sent through secure delivery by April 16, 2024.", "templateId": null}]}
